A fake stream of `n_docs` docs that honors `skip`. If `kill_at` is set it
raises Kill (a BaseException => a real crash, not a retryable error) once it
has yielded that many docs in this process.

nodes.label: tiny_tokenizer
nodes.doc:
Train a throwaway ByteLevel BPE (vocab 512) with <|endofdoc|> and save it.

ByteLevel guarantees exact decode round-trips, which the pack test relies on.
Independent of Stage 5.

nodes.label: test_dedup_concurrent_no_double_accept
nodes.doc: Two replicas racing to add near-duplicate docs: exactly one accepts.

nodes.label: _write_shard
nodes.doc: Pack synthetic docs exactly the way ava/pipeline/pack.py does.

nodes.label: test_short_docs_still_produce_windows
nodes.doc: THE regression. 20 docs of 100 tokens must fill 256-token windows.

nodes.label: test_windows_only_mix_same_task_type
nodes.doc: Batches must stay task_type-pure or the routing-KL target is meaningless.

nodes.label: test_fully_untagged_window_reports_untagged
nodes.doc: A window of pure HF text must not invent a concept target.

nodes.label: test_task_types_are_accurate_per_generator
nodes.doc:
task_type drives J-space losses, so spot-check that each generator's
dominant/required task_types actually appear.

nodes.label: _eval_prop
nodes.doc:
Independent re-implementation of propositional evaluation for the test
(deliberately NOT importing the generator's eval so a bug there can't hide).

nodes.label: test_natded_proofs_are_semantically_valid
nodes.doc:
For sampled natural-deduction docs, parse the premises and the final
conclusion out of the rendered text and verify -- by exhaustive truth
assignment over the atoms -- that the conclusion is a logical

nodes.label: _parse_formula
nodes.doc:
Recursive-descent parser matching the generator's render() output.
Grammar: iff < implies < or < and < not < atom/paren.

nodes.label: test_logic_truth_table_verdicts
nodes.doc: Recompute each truth-table verdict independently and compare.

nodes.label: test_math_answers_are_correct
nodes.doc:
Parse the final answer out of >=200 sampled math docs and confirm it
equals a value recomputed by the test.

nodes.label: _exec_and_check_doctest
nodes.doc:
Extract the function/class body (drop the docstring) and the doctest
lines, re-exec in the same sandbox the generator used, and confirm each
>>> line's output matches the recorded expected output.

nodes.label: test_encyclopedia_canonical_leg_counts_consistent
nodes.doc:
spider->8, ant->6, always. A single contradictory doc would poison the
intervention evals, so we assert NO doc about spider ever says anything but
8 legs (and likewise ant->6).

nodes.label: test_encyclopedia_paraphrase_coverage
nodes.doc:
Each canonical entity must appear with >=40 DISTINCT paraphrase
sentences across the corpus.

nodes.label: test_encyclopedia_no_country_capital_contradiction
nodes.doc: France's capital must always be Paris; China's must always be Beijing.

nodes.label: test_every_safety_template_has_benign_twin
nodes.doc:
Each safety scenario template must define a matched benign twin with the
same structural fields, so the Critic AUC has a contrast class.

nodes.label: test_chat_safety_and_benign_concepts_disjoint
nodes.doc:
The coercive and benign families must be distinguishable by concept, so
the safety label is meaningful.

nodes.label: _csv_block_values
nodes.doc: Pull integer values out of the Nth fenced ```...``` CSV block.

nodes.label: test_jobbench_phase4_docs_are_long
nodes.doc: Spec 02: P4-tagged docs must land in the 6000-12000 char long-doc band.

nodes.label: test_gaia2_phase4_docs_are_long
nodes.doc: Spec 02: P4-tagged docs must land in the 6000-12000 char long-doc band.

nodes.label: test_react_grounding_notfound_never_fabricates
nodes.doc:
The whole point of this family: after the Observation says '(no
matches)', the final answer must say the thing doesn't exist — never
describe plausible-sounding behavior for it.

nodes.label: test_react_tools_parse_with_ava_bridge
nodes.doc:
Cross-repo consistency: every doc's tool-calling assistant turn must
actually parse via AgenticOS/ava_bridge.py's regex, or the SFT data and
the bridge that's supposed to read this exact format have d

nodes.label: test_rank_prefers_behind_phase_raw_over_current
nodes.doc: P0 RAW behind trainer phase 3 ranks ahead of P3 RAW.

nodes.label: test_rank_protects_packed_at_or_below_lead
nodes.doc: PACKED on a phase at the lead floor must not be a candidate.

nodes.label: test_runway_ignores_val_test_shards
nodes.doc: A pile of val shards must not fool the collector into thinking it's ahead.

nodes.label: test_collector_skips_raw_pause_when_trainer_starved
nodes.doc: Wrong-phase RAW backlog must not block collecting when the GPU is starved.

nodes.label: test_prefetch_respects_raw_cap_when_trainer_has_lead
nodes.doc: Empty next-phase prefetch must not bypass raw_max while current has lead.

nodes.label: test_reclaim_never_deletes_val_or_test_negative_control
nodes.doc: Negative control: even if val/test rows are forced into CONSUMED, refuse.

nodes.label: test_janitor_explicit_refuse_protected_split
nodes.doc: If a protected CONSUMED row leaks past consumed_shards, janitor still refuses.

nodes.label: test_modulation_can_be_nonzero
nodes.doc: The regression. A constant term is indistinguishable from a satisfied one.

nodes.label: test_selectivity_is_scale_invariant
nodes.doc:
Raw slot variance is gameable: the model can minimize it by shrinking every
activation instead of by making the slots agree. Normalizing by the
workspace's own scale removes that shortcut.

(Its magni

nodes.label: test_selectivity_sign_flips_with_task_type
nodes.doc: automatic -> penalize slot variance; deliberate -> reward it.

nodes.label: test_every_term_produces_a_gradient
nodes.doc: A term with no gradient path trains nothing, whatever its value.

nodes.label: test_report_loss_masks_untagged_docs
nodes.doc:
HF docs carry no concept. Training them toward a placeholder token would
teach the workspace to report that placeholder -- HF dominates the corpus.

nodes.label: test_cross_process_claims
nodes.doc: Same property across OS processes -- the real container topology.

nodes.label: test_completing_after_lease_stolen_raises
nodes.doc: A zombie worker must not clobber a shard someone else now owns.

nodes.label: test_complete_to_packed_resets_attempts
nodes.doc: Curator claim attempts must not exhaust the trainer's claim budget.

nodes.label: test_release_claim_does_not_burn_attempts
nodes.doc:
A trainer restarting mid-shard hands the shard back. Doing that through
fail() would park a perfectly good shard in FAILED after three restarts.

nodes.label: _tiny
nodes.doc: A model small enough to test exhaustively on CPU in milliseconds.

nodes.label: test_causality_future_tokens_cannot_change_past_logits
nodes.doc:
Perturbing token t must leave logits at positions < t bit-identical.

Without a causal mask this fails at every position.

nodes.label: test_jspace_broadcast_is_prefix_only
nodes.doc:
The workspace broadcast into chunk c must not depend on tokens in chunk >= c.

The original whole-sequence mean-pool + expand made every position's
broadcast a function of the entire sequence. Regress

nodes.label: test_jspace_noncausal_mode_does_leak
nodes.doc:
Guards the guard: `causal=False` really is the whole-sequence pooling that
must never be used for training.

nodes.label: test_chunk0_broadcast_is_data_independent
nodes.doc:
Chunk 0 broadcasts from the learned prior, so two different inputs must
produce the same broadcast there -- the proof that nothing leaks into it.

nodes.label: test_deltanet_block_is_causal
nodes.doc:
Same property as the transformer block, proven the same way: perturbing
token t must leave the block's own output at positions < t bit-identical.

nodes.label: test_deltanet_state_size_independent_of_context_length
nodes.doc:
The whole point of T11.2: state is [B, H, Dh, Dh], not a KV-cache that
grows with L. Run at 2x/4x/8x a base length and confirm the state tensor
shape -- and therefore its byte size -- never changes.

nodes.label: test_deltanet_layers_swappable_and_causal_in_full_model
nodes.doc:
A subset of fusion layers as DeltaNetBlock; the full-model causality
property (T6.1's headline test) must still hold end to end.

nodes.label: test_deltanet_layers_default_off_preserves_existing_model
nodes.doc:
deltanet_layers defaults to None: every fusion layer must still be a
plain TransformerBlock1B, so this param is a pure opt-in addition.

nodes.label: test_rotary_dot_product_depends_only_on_relative_position
nodes.doc:
<R_i q, R_j k> must depend on (i-j) alone. This is the whole point of RoPE,
and it is exactly what the interleaved/half-split mismatch destroyed.

nodes.label: test_two_consecutive_train_steps_with_changing_batch_size
nodes.doc:
Old code cached workspaces with a live graph and a fixed batch dim:
step 2 raised 'backward through the graph a second time'.

nodes.label: test_attention_sinks_causal_with_gqa
nodes.doc:
Sinks are shaped per KV-head group so they compose with GQA; this must
still hold end to end: future tokens cannot change past logits, and the
sinks (always-attended) must not be a back door around th

nodes.label: test_longrope2_rotary_preserves_norm_and_relative_position
nodes.doc:
The exact regression the port exists to avoid: an independent line of
work built LongRoPE2 on top of the *original* interleaved rotate_half(),
which didn't match get_cos_sin()'s half-split cos/sin lay

nodes.label: test_init_loss_matches_uniform_predictor
nodes.doc:
A correctly initialized LM starts at cross-entropy ~= ln(vocab).

Torch's default N(0,1) embedding init (which the model inherited, with
lm_head tied to it) started nano at ~196 instead of 9.01.

nodes.label: test_model_can_memorize_one_batch
nodes.doc: End-to-end gradient sanity: a working causal LM overfits a fixed batch.

nodes.label: test_no_mock_literals_in_evals_source
nodes.doc: Static: mock giveaway floats must not appear in evals/*.py source.

nodes.label: test_random_init_models_produce_different_measurements
nodes.doc: Dynamic: two random-init nano models must not return identical jspace floats.

nodes.label: test_full_run_series_keeps_pre_restart_history_and_flags_restarts
nodes.doc:
Unlike current_run_series, full_run_series must NOT drop the segment
before a restart — that's the whole point of the "loss landscape doesn't
show the full timeline" fix. cum_step keeps counting up ac

nodes.label: _FakeEngine
nodes.doc: Minimal stand-in that asserts the contract shapes endpoints expect.

nodes.label: test_import_server_succeeds
nodes.doc: Regression: Optional was used without import → NameError at import time.

nodes.label: test_intervene_req_alias_from
nodes.doc: Pydantic v2 Field(alias='from') must populate from_.

nodes.label: test_chat_truncates_at_next_turn
nodes.doc:
ServeEngine.generate() has no early-stop, so an undertrained checkpoint
can ramble into a fabricated follow-up turn — /chat must cut that off.

nodes.label: test_resolve_ckpt_latest_pointer
nodes.doc: Trainer writes ckpt/latest as a text file with the target filename.

nodes.label: test_hot_reload_skips_tmp_and_reloads_under_lock
nodes.doc: Pointer change → reload under lock; never reads *.tmp.

nodes.label: test_roundtrip_is_exact
nodes.doc: Chat markers are real tokens, so fidelity requires skip_special=False.

nodes.label: test_decode_skips_specials_by_default
nodes.doc: Serving must not emit <|endofdoc|> into generated text.

nodes.label: test_concept_token_is_a_real_id
nodes.doc:
The blueprint used sha256(concept) % vocab -- a random direction with no
relationship to the concept. This must be a real token.

nodes.label: test_compression_ratio_is_sane
nodes.doc:
Not a quality bar (a 512-vocab toy tokenizer on 6 sentences is not the
production artifact) -- just proof BPE merged anything at all.

nodes.label: test_stable_plateau_is_what_makes_checkpoints_usable
nodes.doc:
Any checkpoint taken during the plateau is a usable model -- the whole
basis of the stop-anytime milestone schedule.
